recognize_zh: 骨髓切片低倍下，骨小樑間多個黏聚的腫瘤細胞巢呈強烈棕色細胞質 PSA 陽性，周圍造血細胞與脂肪細胞為陰性，符合轉移性攝護腺癌侵犯骨髓。
features: Multiple cohesive tumor nests of variable size infiltrating intertrabecular marrow spaces
Strong, diffuse cytoplasmic (brown) PSA staining in tumor cells with some gland-like lumens
Background hematopoietic cells and adipocytes negative
Decalcified bone trabeculae with blue counterstain; low-power view
describe_en: Low-power view of a bone marrow trephine biopsy immunostained for prostate-specific antigen shows several cohesive nests of tumor cells within the intertrabecular spaces, some forming small lumen-like spaces. The tumor cells show strong, diffuse cytoplasmic PSA positivity, whereas the residual hematopoietic marrow and fat are negative. Findings are consistent with metastatic prostatic adenocarcinoma involving the bone marrow.

ddx.vs: Urothelial carcinoma is PSA and NKX3.1 negative and positive for GATA3 and p63.
Non-prostatic adenocarcinomas are PSA negative and express site markers such as CDX2/SATB2, TTF-1, or GATA3.

ddx.dx: High-grade or treatment-related prostatic carcinoma with PSA loss
ddx.vs: Poorly differentiated prostatic cancer may show weak or absent PSA, in which case NKX3.1 and PSMA are more sensitive.
